subject: [PATCH v5 02/11] mm, swap: support zswap and zero-filled swap pages as vswap backends

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch adds support for virtual swap (vswap) using zswap and zero-filled swap pages as backends, allowing compressed or zero-filled pages to be stored without pre-allocating physical swap space. It introduces a new vswap layer that decouples PTE swap entries from physical backing, enabling efficient compression and detection of zero-filled pages. The patch also includes changes to handle virtual swap-backed entries in the zswap shrinker and writeback paths, as well as updates to mem_cgroup_can_swap() to account for vswap's contribution to memory pressure. Additionally, it introduces a new function mem_cgroup_can_vswap() to determine whether vswap is enabled for a given cgroup.
